children: Spain's Pablo Hernandez de Cos will become the next president of the European Central Bank and succeed Christine Lagarde in February after a majority of euro zone countries endorsed him, the Financial Times reported on Thursday, citing people familiar with the matter.
Reuters could not immediately verify the report.
